description: The review's final reply (2026-11-17): the verdict of the checklist it wrote, so the orchestrator can check it against the file.

verdict.description: The last line of the checklist you wrote; NOT_WRITTEN when you wrote none (say why in note).

return_to.description: The RETURN line of a REVISE; none otherwise.

problems.description: Problem entries that state a problem.

replacements.description: Wording replacements in the replacements block.

note.description: One sentence: what the checklist says, or why none was written (a bug you filed, a tool that failed).
